instructions: 只編輯 target_zh_TW 與 translator_note。空白 target 匯出時保留英文；這份 JSON 不是遊戲原生格式。

entries.source: Create New Pilot Please enter the new pilot name.
entries.target_zh_TW: 建立新飛行員 請輸入新飛行員的名稱。

entries.source: This pilot name already exists, please choose a unique name.
entries.target_zh_TW: 此飛行員名稱已存在，請選擇其他名稱。
重設飛行員（僅限本遊戲）

entries.source: Delete Existing Pilot The existing pilot data can be reset for the current game only (losing all progress, scores, and so on), or the pilot can be permanently deleted for all games. Do you wish to continue?
entries.target_zh_TW: 刪除現有飛行員 可以僅針對目前遊戲重設現有飛行員資料（將失去所有進度、分數等），或在所有遊戲中永久刪除該飛行員。 是否要繼續？

entries.source: Revive Pilot This pilot will be revived, allowing progress from the last saved point. The score will be set to zero. Do you wish to continue?
entries.target_zh_TW: 復活飛行員 此飛行員將會復活，並可從上次儲存的進度繼續。分數將歸零。 是否要繼續？

entries.source:
Images will be stretched to a 217:325 aspect ratio.
Supported file formats are jpg and png.
entries.target_zh_TW:
圖片將被拉伸為 217:325 的長寬比。
支援的檔案格式為 jpg 與 png。

entries.source: Portrait Gallery Select the desired pilot portrait below, or cancel to keep your previous selection.
entries.target_zh_TW: 肖像圖庫 請在下方選擇想要的飛行員肖像，或取消以保留先前的選擇。

entries.source:
Cheat settings are enabled.
Tour progression is not allowed: you may play this mission, but will not be able to advance to the next until cheats are disabled.
entries.target_zh_TW:
已啟用作弊設定。
無法推進服役期進度：你可以進行此任務，但在停用作弊之前無法晉級到下一個任務。

entries.source:
Cheat settings were enabled when this mission was played.
Tour progression is not allowed: you will need to disable cheat options and replay the mission to advance to the next mission.
entries.target_zh_TW:
進行此任務時已啟用作弊設定。
無法推進服役期進度：你必須停用作弊選項並重新進行此任務，才能晉級到下一個任務。

entries.source: Import Original pilot Select original game pilot to import.
entries.target_zh_TW: 匯入原版飛行員 請選擇要匯入的原版遊戲飛行員。

entries.source: This pilot name already exists, please delete this pilot first or import another.
entries.target_zh_TW: 此飛行員名稱已存在，請先刪除此飛行員，或匯入其他飛行員。

entries.source:
Cheat settings were active during this mission.
Campaign progression will be tolerated for this mission.
However, remember to disable cheat settings  for subsequent missions.
entries.target_zh_TW:
此任務中曾啟用作弊設定。
本任務仍允許推進戰役進度。
不過，請記得在後續任務中停用作弊設定。

entries.source:
You have attempted this mission a few times now.
Do you need a bit of plot armor?
If you use cheat settings during your next attempts, we'll pretend you didn't.
Up to you.
entries.target_zh_TW:
你已經挑戰這個任務好幾次了。
需要一點主角光環嗎？
如果你在接下來的嘗試中使用作弊設定，我們會假裝沒看到。
由你決定。

entries.source: Progress to {nextRank}: ((Must reach {bestScore} to start progressing again.))
entries.target_zh_TW: 晉升{nextRank}進度：((須達到 {bestScore} 分才能再次累積進度。))

entries.source:
Pass through the gates as quickly as you can, before the timer runs out.

For the best score, fly through the gates in the correct order.

Watch out for the laser turrets!
entries.target_zh_TW:
請在計時結束前，盡快穿過所有閘門。

依正確順序穿過閘門，才能獲得最高分。

小心雷射砲塔！

entries.source: Clone Pilot This pilot will be cloned with a new name. While the original pilot might be dead or captured, the clone will not.
entries.target_zh_TW: 複製飛行員 將以新名稱複製此飛行員。即使原飛行員已陣亡或遭俘，複製出的飛行員也不會沿用該狀態。

entries.source: Please enter a valid pilot name!
entries.target_zh_TW: 請輸入有效的飛行員名稱！

entries.source: The clone must have a different name than other pilots.
entries.target_zh_TW: 複製的飛行員名稱必須與其他飛行員不同。
重設擊殺數與統計紀錄

entries.source:
This pilot is dead!

Revive, clone, or create a new pilot to continue.
entries.target_zh_TW:
此飛行員已陣亡！

請復活、複製或建立新飛行員以繼續。

entries.source:
This pilot is captured!

Revive, clone, or create a new pilot to continue.
entries.target_zh_TW:
此飛行員已遭俘！

請復活、複製或建立新飛行員以繼續。

entries.source:
You must register!

Select or create a pilot to continue.
entries.target_zh_TW:
你必須先註冊！

請選擇或建立飛行員以繼續。
複製飛行員時發生錯誤：

entries.source: This pilot name already exists, please choose a unique name.
entries.target_zh_TW: 此飛行員名稱已存在，請選擇其他名稱。

entries.source: This pilot name already exists, please delete the existing pilot first or import another.
entries.target_zh_TW: 此飛行員名稱已存在，請先刪除現有的飛行員，或匯入其他飛行員。
匯入飛行員時發生錯誤。
